fixture_context: Target fixture: a cylindrical lamp, 500 LEDs on a helix, radius 0.08 m, height 0.30 m (+Y up, led.pos in metres, led.uv = top-down projection), topology = 8 chained segments. Frame budget 33 ms at 30 fps.

prompts.text: a calm ocean swell rolling up the lamp
a slow rainbow rotating around the lamp (cylindrical)
a heartbeat pulse from the centre outward
thunderstorm: dark clouds with lightning flashes
a sunrise: warm glow climbing from the bottom
a scanner beam sweeping left to right
